title: Technical Drawing & Railway Documentation

canonicalTerminology.definition: An engineering drawing is a controlled graphical technical document used to communicate geometry, dimensions, interfaces and other design information.

claims.text: Railway technical documentation must preserve identity, revision status, traceability and unambiguous communication between design, production, maintenance and inspection activities.
claims.applicabilityNote: Level-neutral educational statement; adapt depth without changing the canonical fact.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show a controlled drawing and document lifecycle rather than reproducing proprietary drawings.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not fabricate drawing approvals, revision history or manufacturer data.
Do not reproduce proprietary technical drawings as canonical training content.
